# Hero Memory Phase B — trait level, Wax & Wane, revival mod

- **Status:** ✅ Confirmed
- **Skills affected:** Hero Memories
- **Mechanic tags:** hero-memory, hero-trait, trait-level, wax-and-wane
- **Last verified:** 2026-08-08 by owner (in-game)

## Setup

Owner confirmed all three mechanics directly in-game (2026-08-08). Wax & Wane's +30% is explicitly worded on the item in-game (base-stat line shows '(+30%)').

## Raw data points

Trait level: unleveled memory = 1; a '+2 to Hero Trait Level' fixed affix adds +2 (→ 3); memory level 30+ adds +1; level 50 adds a further +1. A level-50 Ultimate with a +2 fixed = 5 (the cap). An Epic (max level 40) with a +2 fixed = 4. Wax & Wane: a +90 base stat becomes +117 (×1.3).

## Derived / confirmed formula

traitSlotLevel(socketed memory) = clamp(1 + (memLevel>=30?1:0) + (memLevel>=50?1:0) + Σ("+N to Hero Trait Level" fixed mods), 1, 5). The level is SET by the socketed memory (not added to a base); an EMPTY slot leaves that advanced trait INACTIVE (level 0). Wax & Wane: base-stat value × 1.3 (base stat ONLY), applied locally at the memory source before the global %-attribute pools.

## Notes / caveats / open questions

DEFERRED (not modeled yet): the 4th 'Base/Special' memory slot. In-game, a revived mod lets you slot a chosen type (origin/discipline/progress) into the base slot to level the BASE trait (→ level 5 = Artificial Moon, the only path), but that slot's BASE + RANDOM affixes are reduced by a percentage while FIXED affixes are unpenalized. The exact penalty % is not yet recorded, and the 4th memory type is not in the data model, so base-slot leveling and the penalty are NOT implemented — traitSlotLevels[0] passes through unchanged. INTENDED behavior change shipped with Phase B: an advanced trait with no socketed memory now computes as inactive (previously it could contribute from a stored slot level).

## Implementation (engine model)

Renderer-side (no backend/engine change; the engine already consumes trait_slot_levels + memory_effects).

(1) TRAIT LEVEL: `deriveTraitSlotLevels(heroMemories, stored)` (api/client.ts) SETs traitSlotLevels[1..3] (origin/discipline/progress → the 45/60/75 advanced-trait tiers) to `memoryTraitLevel(memory)`, or 0 (inactive) when the slot is empty; base slot [0] passes through. It is the single source of truth used by the payload builder (utils/statsPayload.ts — trait_slot_levels + both withGuaranteedPicks/_effTraitPicks calls + buildTraitEffects) AND the display readers (HeroTraitScreen tier level/enabled, PlayerStatsScreen node tooltip). Tree-mode traits (Selena 'Dance of the Deep') keep their stored levels (they use allocations, not tiers). Base trait level 5 → Artificial Moon, reachable only via the base/special slot (see below).

(2) WAX & WANE: in `buildMemoryEffects` (api/client.ts), a revived memory's base-stat value is ×1.3 (base stat only) before it becomes a memory_effect — a local multiplier at the source, mirroring foldLocalGearDefense; it then scales by the normal %-attribute pools downstream.

(3) REVIVAL MOD: `buildMemoryEffects` now emits a revived memory's revivalMod as a normal memory_effect (parsed by the memory resolver like any affix); exotic revival mods that don't map are surfaced via memory_mod_statuses, not dropped. The '+N to Hero Trait Level' fixed mod is excluded from memory_effects (it feeds the trait level instead).
